message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Two newly reported vulnerabilities were verified as relevant to the monitored products during the last 24 hours (2026-08-17 05:10 IST to 2026-08-18 05:10 IST). Both affect Notepad++ versions before 8.9.7.

**Finding 1**

- Product: Notepad++
- Issue: CVE-2026-54758 — stack buffer overflow in `expandNppEnvironmentStrs`
- Severity: High (CVSS 3.1: 7.8)
- Why it matters: A specially crafted Notepad++ variable name can overflow a fixed-size stack buffer, causing a crash and potentially code execution. Exploitation is local and requires user interaction. This directly matches the monitored Notepad++ product; versions before 8.9.7 are affected.
- Source: [Notepad++ maintainer advisory](https://github.com/notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus/security/advisories/GHSA-gv94-327x-2gc5)

**Finding 2**

- Product: Notepad++
- Issue: CVE-2026-71858 — `shortcuts.xml` macro HMAC bypass
- Severity: Medium (CVSS 4.0: 5.4)
- Why it matters: An attacker-controlled macro configuration can bypass validation and, under specific local conditions, modify protected files or execute commands when Notepad++ is elevated and the user triggers the macro. This directly matches the monitored Notepad++ product; versions before 8.9.7 are affected.
- Source: [Notepad++ maintainer advisory](https://github.com/notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus/security/advisories/GHSA-f4rj-vqq4-wvg4)

**Possible matches needing review:** None.

Immediate review is recommended for the high-severity buffer overflow. Confirm deployed Notepad++ versions and prioritize the vendor-fixed 8.9.7 release where applicable. No other monitored-product findings were verified in the window.
